steps.content: It doesn't take long to return to the frontline from the WhiteSands Border, but you take a detour to avoid surveillance. This way, you won't have to waste time explaining to the higher-ups.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's what happened, basically. The FAC retrieved the materials again. Yanyan and the envoys worked hard to patch up the sorcery. The Ring Research Institute also set up resonance devices all over DisCity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Time's not on our side, so the product is roughly only 40% of the original effectiveness. As DisCity's first attempt at the bow... Well, we did our best.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: So, what will you do next?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Come help us prepare for the second Sun Shot and let Yanyan have another try?
Du Ruo turns around to see you come out of the makeshift changing room, having just changed into the special Eastian Sun Shot attire. Her face seems to say, "Ohhh."
That teasing smile always gives you the shivers.

options: I didn't ask for the spotlight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've tried both Yanyan and the FAC, but they've all refused. And yet they want the ritual to look authentic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why don't you do it? You were the one holding the bow seven years ago, right?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sorry, I've spent too much time buried in the books...
Classic Du Ruo. You used to find such detachment cold and aloof, but now...
You can somehow feel the calm trust in her ever-poised smile.
You grab the DisCity-made Sun Shot Bow. The moment you pull the bow, the flames shooting out of it scorch your body. You hear an indistinct voice.
Are you confident you can do it?
It's hard to say. After all, you have never been to Eastia or lived those times. You don't understand those embedded emotions.
But you believe that even if you fail, the city will withstand this trial, somehow.
Not just this time. You've witnessed so much all along. As you draw the bow, scenes flash across your mind.

The soldiers who stood in front of you. The weak ones who helped each other up after being abandoned. The companions who always trusted and followed you in desperate situations. And those who have never seen you but sing the praises of your stories.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If the story of this incident spreads to other places, I'm sure many would just laugh it off as some exaggerated tale. It probably sounds less intriguing than the Hypercube cult.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But these are the memories we've truly lived in this city. If the Almighty Bow allows it, I won't mind recounting them personally.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Congratulations, you gave the right answer.
She comes to your side and takes your hand, helping you lift the Almighty Bow light as a feather yet heavy as a stele.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Don't rush. This is Eastia's special archery ritual. Xu never taught you this in your dreams, did she?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: No worries, I'm here. I'll teach you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You are very smart. I'm sure you'll get the hang of it right away.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Lower your shoulders. Open up your chest. Use your back muscles and keep your arms level, just like this...
She lifts your arms and surrounds you with her smoke, helping you suppress the sinister fire spilling out of the bow and the chaotic whispers from all over DisCity.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Next, listen carefully...
In the darkness, the world suddenly quiets down. The noise of the border's sandstorm and those inexplicable whispers all fade away.
The bowstring suppresses the Mania and the bow trembles as familiar figures emerge in your mind.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The equipment has fused again. We can't mend the gap now. The Apostles will soon...
A soldier cries out as his Hypercube shield shatters. Just as a monster is about to pounce on him, a large shield lands before him firmly.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Sir?!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I got this. Go fix the equipment or find a backup. Hurry!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: But...
The officer dawdles no more and turns to charge at the next monster. In the flurry of the battlefield, he doesn't notice a new threat approaching from the side.
The patterned green light shining down from above clears the threat beside him. The soldier instantly recognizes who has helped him.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: It's the Eastian sorcery!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Heh, like I need their help.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Yanyan, leave this to us. Don't overexert yourself!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It's okay, I can hold on. It's my turn to support everyone now...
Syndicans gather in squares everywhere, looking up at the sky with anxious hearts filled with unfounded hope.
At the Rust, scavengers sit together and pray softly. Even in Eastside, hurried passersby halt their steps. They all hear it.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: What do you hear?
The echoes continue as more and more people flash past your memory. Gradually, you begin to hear vague shouts, the sparse voices drawing closer and growing more unified.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I hear... what you hear. People are afraid and panicking, but they also want to survive the calamity. The simplest wish becomes the unbreakable myth that crosses mountains and seas.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: For someone who doesn't believe in the myth, you're quite enthusiastic about drawing the bow each time.
She chuckles.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Beneath the lies, what I believe has never changed.
Under the joint attack of Eastia and the FAC, the enraged Sun Crow spreads its wings, assuming an offensive posture. At that moment, you feel the arrow on the bow trembles slightly.
A flame not belonging to the Sun Crow flows like an invisible hand brushing over the arrow. Suddenly, the bowstring feels less taut and no longer hurts your hand.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Perfect. It's all ready now. Come on, hero.

The moment you let go, this arrow mixed with flames, your shackles, and the healing smoke soars as if alive. The fletching draws a long rainbow in the air, instantly leaving your sight, but you are certain it will hit its mark.
The arrow is propelled by undying fire in the gaze of every soldier and every citizen holding their small hope... and it hits the chest of the Sun Crow precisely.

steps.speaker: Sun Crow Apostle
steps.content: Roarrr!!!!

The Sun Crow lets out a painful roar, attempting once more to swallow the arrow with its body as it did once before. However, the moment the arrow sinks into its chest, flames burst forth from the wound, burning and tearing its disguise from the inside out.
The burning feathers peel away from its body layer by layer, merging with the countless suns in the sky before splitting off again, finally settling in the form prophesied by the mural...
Everyone sees it. A blurry figure flashing across the ten suns...

It's the small figure of a mere human, but it may well be an everlasting simple prayer. The lie left behind seven years ago has now crossed thousands of miles, once again transforming into a sword that pierces the chest of the calamity.
You know that now is the moment.
